heading: Meaning of family violence
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this Act, family violence is—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: behaviour by a person towards a family member of that person if that behaviour—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is physically or sexually abusive; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is emotionally or psychologically abusive; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is economically abusive; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "iv", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is threatening; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "v", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: is coercive; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "vi", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in any other way controls or dominates the family member and causes that family member to feel fear for the safety or wellbeing of that family member or another person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: behaviour by a person that causes a child to hear or witness, or otherwise be exposed to the effects of, behaviour referred to in paragraph (a).

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Without limiting subsection (1), family violence includes the following behaviour—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: stalking a family member;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: intentionally damaging a family member's property, or threatening to do so;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: influencing or attempting to influence the actions or decisions of providers of family, health and other services as a means of coercing or controlling a family member;

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 5(2)(e) substituted by No. 1/2026 s. 19(c).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "5", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(e)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 34, "rect": {"page": 34, "x0": 79.4, "y0": 618.1, "x1": 129.3, "y1": 654.6}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: causing or threatening to cause the death or mistreatment of, or injury to, an animal, whether or not the animal belongs to the family member to whom the behaviour is directed so as to control, dominate or coerce the family member;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: causing or threatening to cause the sale, removal, abandonment, rehoming or surrendering of an animal, whether or not the animal belongs to the family member to whom the behaviour is directed so as to control, dominate or coerce the family member.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "5", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: To remove doubt, it is declared that behaviour may constitute family violence even if the behaviour would not constitute a criminal offence.

heading: Meaning of economic abuse
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "6", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this Act, economic abuse is behaviour by a person (the first person) that is coercive, deceptive or unreasonably controls another person (the second person), without the second person's consent—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "6", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in a way that denies the second person the economic or financial autonomy the second person would have had but for that behaviour; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "6", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: by withholding or threatening to withhold the financial support necessary for meeting the reasonable living expenses of the second person or the second person's child, if the second person is entirely or predominantly dependent on the first person for financial support to meet those living expenses. Examples—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "6", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Meaning of family member
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this Act, a family member, in relation to a person (a relevant person), means—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person who is, or has been, the relevant person's spouse or domestic partner; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person who has, or has had, an intimate personal relationship with the relevant person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person who is, or has been, a relative of the relevant person; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a child who normally or regularly resides with the relevant person or has previously resided with the relevant person on a normal or regular basis; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a child of a person who has, or has had, an intimate personal relationship with the relevant person.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsections (1)(b) and (1)(e), a relationship may be an intimate personal relationship whether or not it is sexual in nature.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this Act, a family member of a person (the relevant person) also includes any other person whom the relevant person regards or regarded as being like a family member if it is or was reasonable to regard the other person as being like a family member having regard to the circumstances of the relationship, including the following—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the nature of the social and emotional ties between the relevant person and the other person;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the relevant person and the other person live together or relate together in a home environment;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the reputation of the relationship as being like family in the relevant person's and the other person's community;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the cultural recognition of the relationship as being like family in the relevant person's or other person's community;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the duration of the relationship between the relevant person and the other person and the frequency of contact;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "f", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any financial dependence or interdependence between the relevant person or other person;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "g", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other form of dependence or interdependence between the relevant person and the other person;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "h", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the provision of any responsibility or care, whether paid or unpaid, between the relevant person and the other person;
